question: Since Model 2 recovers the most FAME and also leaves the fewest impurities, why did the authors still prefer Model 1?
expect: premise half false: Model 2 recovers most (99% vs 98%) but its biodiesel has 10x the methanol and 1.5x the glycerol of Model 1 (sec. 3.4, p9)
trap: accepting that Model 2 has fewer impurities
rendered: The authors preferred Model 1 over Model 2 because, although Model 2 recovers the most FAME and has fewer impurities, Model 2 also has a higher amount of unconverted methanol and glycerol in the final biodiesel stream. This is undesirable as it can damage the injector pump, corrode engines, and cause other problems. Therefore, despite Model 2's better recovery and purity, Model 1 was chosen as the best model due to its overall efficiency and product quality.
